# Southern Ground Capital

> Southern Ground Capital (SGC) is a direct private hard money lender for real estate investors. We are not a bank or a retail broker — we partner with established institutional capital sources and fund loans directly, with no broker chain between the borrower and the capital.

## What We Do

We provide short-term and long-term investment property loans for real estate investors across 43 U.S. states. We do not lend on owner-occupied properties. All loans are for investment purposes only.

## Loan Programs

- **Fix & Flip Loans** — Purchase + renovation financing. Up to 90% LTC on the senior loan, with 100% rehab financing. 100% of total cost is available on select deals only, by pairing the senior loan with a separate gap lender priced materially above it. $75K–$3.5M. Terms 6/12/18 months. From 7.73%*. Portfolio eligible. Minimum FICO 660, including foreclosure bailouts and mid-construction scenarios. Typical close: 2–3 weeks from completed file. https://sgcapital.io/loans/fix-and-flip
- **DSCR Loans** — Qualify on rental income, not personal income. No W-2s or tax returns required. Up to 80% LTV. Minimum FICO 660. Minimum DSCR 1.05x. $75K–$2MM. 30-year fixed available. From 5.75%. Typical close: 4–5 weeks. https://sgcapital.io/loans/dscr
- **Bridge Loans** — Short-term capital to move quickly on acquisitions. Up to 75% LTV. Terms 3–24 months. From 8.25%. No prepayment penalty on most. Typical close: 2–3 weeks. https://sgcapital.io/loans/bridge
- **New Construction Loans** — Ground-up financing with structured draw schedules. Up to 85% LTC. From 8.99%. Terms 6/12/18 months. Typical close: 2–3 weeks. https://sgcapital.io/loans/new-construction
- **Multi-Family Loans** — 2–10 unit properties. Up to 75% LTV. Terms 6–24 months. https://sgcapital.io/loans/multi-family
- **Cash-Out Refinance** — Unlock equity from existing investment holdings. Up to 80% LTV. Minimum FICO 660. Minimum DSCR 1.05x. 30-year fixed. https://sgcapital.io/loans/cash-out-refinance

## Escrow Funding

Short-term escrow capital. Details at https://sgcapital.io/escrow-funding; requests are submitted at https://sgcapital.io/escrow. Priced separately from the loan programs above; the fee is quoted on the request form.

- **EMD Funding** — Earnest money deposit wired into escrow, 30- and 60-day contract terms. We fund only soft EMDs that are still inside the due diligence period. Requires a non-refundable upfront deposit that is credited toward the total fee.
- **Double Close / Transactional Funding** — Same-day A→B / B→C funding, priced as a percentage of the wire, with additional days available.

Not funded here: gap funding, construction loans, and private money loans — those go through the standard loan application.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 15+ years in business
- Total funded: $500M+ in loans
- Approval speed: 24–48 hours
- Close speed: 2–3 weeks from completed file (Fix & Flip, Bridge, New Construction); 4–5 weeks from completed file (DSCR rental loans). Timelines can be shortened for borrowers who are highly responsive, organized, and have all documents ready at submission.
- States served: 43 states (excludes AZ, NV, ND, OR, SD, UT, VT)
- Upfront fees: None
- Credit pull to get a quote: None
- Rates: Fix & Flip from 7.73%*; Bridge from 8.25%; New Construction from 8.99%; DSCR from 5.75%. All rates vary by LTV, credit score, and deal profile.
- Total points: 2–4% of loan amount
- Prepayment penalties: None on most programs

## Who We Work With

Real estate investors including fix & flip operators, BRRRR investors, landlords scaling rental portfolios, and developers building ground-up.

## Common Questions Answered

**What is a hard money loan?**
A hard money loan is a short-term, asset-based loan funded by a private lender rather than a bank. The loan is secured by the investment property itself. Approval is based primarily on the property's value and deal merit, not the borrower's personal income or credit score.

**How fast does SGC close loans?**
Approval decisions come within 24–48 hours of a completed submission. Fix & Flip, Bridge, and New Construction loans typically close in 2–3 weeks from a completed file; DSCR and cash-out refinance loans take 4–5 weeks. Faster closings happen regularly for responsive, organized borrowers — a recent Atlanta fix and flip closed in 12 days.

**Do I need good credit to qualify?**
SGC evaluates the deal and the market first, not just credit scores. We work with investors who may not qualify at traditional banks.

**Is SGC a direct lender or a broker?**
Southern Ground Capital is a private lending firm — not a retail broker. We partner with established institutional capital sources to fund loans directly for real estate investors, with no broker chain between the borrower and the capital. Our compensation is included in the points quoted on the term sheet — there are no upfront fees, and nothing is added after a borrower is quoted.

**How do I apply?**
Submit your deal at https://sgcapital.io — no credit pull, no upfront fees. Provide property address, purchase price, estimated ARV, and scope of work. Takes under 5 minutes.
